surprise.title: Golden light from 6:28 to 7:02 PM
surprise.body: Tallahassee gets a perfectly clear evening, with zero cloud cover forecast and no rain, so tonight's light should be clean and warm. The sun drops below six degrees at about 6:28 PM and sets at 7:02 PM, which gives you roughly half an hour of soft, flattering portrait light. Blue hour follows from about 7:16 to 7:25 PM if you want a cooler, moody frame after sunset. Temperatures ease from about 72°F at 6 PM to the mid 60s by 7, so it is comfortable for a Westcott or campus session.

source.label: Sunset and twilight from sunrise-sunset.org; sky and temperature from Open-Meteo
